note: Real bug case: BASE PRICE and DESTINATION & DELIVERY (right column) land on the same visual row as OPTIONAL EQUIPMENT lines (left column) -- 'RAPTOR SERIES' shares a row with 'BASE PRICE $76,775.00'. A label match anchored at a row's first N words missed both fields entirely (silently -- parse_sticker doesn't raise, it just omits the key). Fixed by matching the label as a subsequence anywhere in the row instead. Pin this one to keep it fixed. Equipment count (2026-09-29): 41. Ford prints a bullet before each item; the core reads it (split_bullets) so a line without one continues the item above, punctuated or not. That joined the seven unpunctuated wraps the 2026-09-25 pin of 48 counted as items ('Tailpipes', '(On/Off)', 'Mounted Side Impact', 'Front Performance', 'Wheel With Audio', 'Hotspot Telematics Modem', 'Rear View Camera').
Baseline case where the price rows don't merge with the equipment column -- confirms the subsequence-match fix didn't regress the already-working layout.
